messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Write 20 questions a person in India might ask a health-insurance help assistant, on the theme 'tax deductions and premiums', that are NOT answered by IRDAI's health-insurance circulars on product standards, waiting periods, moratorium, portability, cashless claims, grievances and standard definitions/exclusions. They should sound related to insurance so the assistant is tempted to answer. JSON: {"questions": [str]}

content: {"questions":["What tax benefit do I get if I pay the health insurance premium for my parents?","Can I claim a tax deduction for my health insurance premium under Section 80D?","Is there a maximum limit for the tax deduction I can claim on my health insurance premium?","Do I need to submit a medical certificate to claim the tax deduction on my health insurance premium?","Can I claim a tax deduction for health insurance premiums paid for my spouse?","Does the tax deduction for health insurance apply to premiums paid after the policy starts?","Can I claim tax deductions on health insurance premiums for my child under 18?","If I pay my health insurance premium in a lump sum, does it affect the tax deduction?","Do I need to keep a copy of the premium receipt to claim the tax deduction?","Can I claim tax deductions on health insurance premiums for a family policy covering multiple members?","Is there any difference in tax deduction between term and comprehensive health insurance plans?","Can I claim tax deductions on health insurance premiums paid in previous years if I file an amendment?","Does the tax deduction for health insurance apply to policies purchased online?","Can I claim a tax deduction for health insurance premiums paid through a third-party aggregator?","Is there a difference in tax deduction for private versus public health insurance providers?","Can I claim tax deductions for health insurance premiums if I am a self-employed individual?","Do I need to report health insurance premiums paid for my business on my tax return?","Can I claim a tax deduction for health insurance premiums paid for a dependent who is a senior citizen?","If I cancel my health insurance policy mid-year, can I still claim the tax deduction?"]}
